children: The /v1/* contract every Surfaces client speaks — query, mutate, search, capabilities, tasks, and graph under one versioned namespace.

HTTP API v1 is the single HTTP surface served by the Phoenix API. Every other client — the Go TUI, the bp CLI, the JS SDK, and the Web Demo — is a thin shell over these routes. There is one content model behind it (see Content Model), and /v1 is how Barkpark exposes it.
/v1/data/mutate/:dataset is the write path — see Mutation.
/v1/data/search runs Postgres Search with BM25F ranking and returns Search Facets.
/v1/capabilities returns the Capabilities Manifest that teaches a client the whole API in one call; this is how bp self-discovers its verbs.
/v1/tasks is the task layer the Tasks Plugin rides on.
/v1/graph serves the Content Edges Table for the Graph View and Blast Radius queries.
The manifest is tier-keyed: a token only sees the slice its tier unlocks, which is why existence-hiding (see Auth and Tokens) works the same way for both data and capabilities.

Every route authorizes against an api_tokens row carrying read/write/admin permissions — the full story lives in Auth and Tokens. The flat Mutation route is the notable case: it authorizes on the write permission alone, with no membership gate.
